title: Zora Metric Separation — Posts != createdCoins != Inventory
claim: Zora UI Posts, profile createdCoins.count, deterministic inventory rows, and Merkle leaves are distinct metrics and must retain independent source, timestamp, and receipt state.
summary: 857, 923, and 1.3K can coexist without contradiction when each number remains bound to its metric and observation state. Deception is not inferred from metric difference.
